decisive_items: Mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue
Spindle cells had bland cytomorphology with tapered nuclei and ill-defined cytoplasm
response.rationale: The presence of mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue and thickened collagen bundles, along with the bland cytomorphology of spindle cells, supports the diagnosis of fibrolipomatous hamartoma. While R5, nerve tissue tumor, is a close contender due to the presence of spindle cells, the specific characteristics mentioned in the vignette more strongly support R2.

rejected.why: Lack of comprehensive support for sebaceous hyperplasia beyond initial skin biopsy
Progressive skin thickening is not exclusive to scleroderma and other symptoms do not align
Madelung disease characteristics are not explicitly mentioned in the vignette
Nodular fasciitis is not directly supported by the combination of symptoms and biopsy results
